thread:
julia: Heads-up — CloudCo asked for a hardened IAC kit we can publish to their marketplace. Need conformance tests + CI gating. TL;DR: terraform module + smoke tests + security scans.

sam: Quick q — what level of conformance are we aiming for? terratest + checkov + tfsec, or a lightweight smoke plan/apply?

kevin: CloudCo docs say: terraform fmt/validate, example stacks for AWS and GCP, provider pinning, and an automated publish flow when we tag a release. They also want a signed manifest for marketplace. Link I shared in drive: https://drive.redwood/example-cloudco-guidelines

marta: My suggestion for minimal gating: 1) terraform fmt + validate 2) terraform init + plan (no apply in public CI) 3) containerized terratest smoke for a tiny example env (runs in partner test account) 4) checkov for policy-as-code. tfsec as opt-in.

sam: We should standardize layout too: /modules/<name>/{examples/,tests/,ci/README.md} and include LICENSE + NOTICE and explicit provider_version in examples. Keeps reviewers happy.

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll draft a GitHub Actions workflow. Quick sketch: 
```name: Module CI
on: [push,pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v1
      - name: Terraform fmt check
        run: terraform fmt -check=true
      - name: Init + Validate
        run: terraform init && terraform validate
      - name: Plan
        run: terraform plan -out=plan.out
      - name: Checkov scan
        run: docker run --rm -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/repo bridgecrew/checkov -d /repo
```

julia: That looks solid. Add a step to run `terraform 0.13upgrade` if we detect older syntax? Maybe not — better to document upgrade path. Also we should not store creds in the workflow; terratest should use short-lived creds fetched from partner-vault (we'll exchange via SSO).

marta: For the terratest container, we can use a small Go image that pulls tests from /tests and runs `go test -v ./` with env creds mounted as secrets. I'll add a sample Dockerfile + README in the template.

ci-bot: NOTE: Publishing to CloudCo marketplace requires a signed manifest file and a metadata checksum. See: https://partner.cloudco/example-manifest . CI should generate the manifest and surface any missing fields as PR checks.

kevin: Action items: I will open a PR with the module template + GH workflow stub. @marta can you add the terratest container + a sample smoke test? @julia I'll sync with CloudCo to confirm exact manifest fields and whether tag-based publish is OK.

julia: Sounds good. Target: PR ready by EOD Friday. If you hit blockers, ping #partnerships or DM me directly. :rocket:

marta: Quick checklist I'm adding to the template README: - module inputs/outputs documented - examples for aws and gcp - CI: fmt/validate/plan/checkov - tests: terratest smoke + optional full integration - publish: manifest generator + sign step - CHANGELOG + release tag convention

sam: One more thing — let's add a lightweight `conformance.yml` that partners can run locally (docker compose) to emulate CI checks. Helps reduce churn during partner review.

kevin: I'll include the conformance.yml and a sample Makefile target: `make ci-local` that runs the checks in containers. PR incoming.

julia: Great work, team. We'll regroup after the PR lands and schedule a short handoff call with CloudCo next week.
